source.citation: Cochran LB et al., 1954 (NADC), relaxed G-tolerance distribution, DTIC ADA177986; as cited by Copeland K, Whinnery JE. Cerebral blood flow based computer modeling of Gz-induced effects. DOT/FAA/AM-23/6, 2023, p. 6. Title and authors of the primary report not verified.
source.read: secondary: the primary report returned 403; numbers from the citing report

conditions.protection: None; not fully relaxed (subjects held a control stick)
conditions.onset: Rapid, in plateaus of 0.5 g and then 0.3 g
conditions.event: Peripheral light loss, blackout and unconsciousness, by the load at which each appeared

assumptions: Each plateau is reconstructed as a jump from rest held 15 s, the usual relaxed rapid-onset tolerance run; the plateau length is not given.
Peripheral light loss is read as the symptoms event and blackout as sight lost.
